name: wpgenius/wordpress-plugin-boilerplate
description: WordPress plugin boilerplate: a starter kit for building plugins.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check every PHP file for syntax errors.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Check code against WordPress Coding Standards.
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Automatically fix coding standards issues where possible.
scripts-descriptions.make-pot: Regenerate the translation template in languages/.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit tests (no WordPress install needed).
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis (PHPStan, level set in phpstan.neon.dist).
